headline: Two more arcade classics will play themselves
lede: WATCH batch 14 seats SONAR ABYSS and BOULDER DASH: press Y and each game's own proven solver takes the wheel — the same planner its harness wins with, driving live at real speed.

notes.text: SONAR ABYSS: the wavefront planner (the BFS that maps the dark for the attract demo) now swims for you too — pings on the sonar's own cooldown, strokes timed to its cadence. Reactive per tick, so a mid-cave Y is honest from wherever you sank to.
BOULDER DASH: the solver that proves all four caves winnable digs them in front of you — quota, then the exit door, dodging its own falling rock. Any key or tap takes the shovel back mid-dig.

Harness: 2 new pilots + 12 source pins in watchcheck, phone tripwire 51->53, two mutants killed (supply cut, takeover cut) and restored. One real catch: the shared attract law reserves

for the press prompt — the hint line rides a div. Coverage 52 -> 54.
The #1637 roll keeps its discipline: a seat ships only when the title's own harness already proves the route wins. No proven route, no button — the arcade never fakes a demo.
